Curriculum map

How the 14 lessons map to the learning goals of the public iSAQB CPSA-F curriculum, version 2025.1-rev2-EN (read 2026-11-24). R1 goals will be examined, R2 may be, R3 will not be. Chapter 6 is not relevant for the exam.
